description: This is a Perl script that extracts and processes target, device, kernel, architecture information for a build system, specifically related to OpenWRT target configurations. It runs make commands and parses their output to gather structured data about targets, architectures, kernels, and devices.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information by running make commands and extracting target attributes such as name, architecture, kernel versions, and features.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device information, associating device profiles with device names by analyzing make command output.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Retrieves all target configurations by iterating over target Makefiles.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device info for a specific target/subtarget by invoking parsing functions.
